title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates [0.0352, 0.0352] with a radius of 0.0352. In the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.0312. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0703 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Finally, extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional cylindrical object. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction, resulting in a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object are a length of 0.0703125, a width of 0.0703125, and a height of 0.7500000000000001.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0352, 0.0352)  # Move to the center of the circles
    .circle(0.0352)         # Outer circle
    .circle(0.0312)         # Inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Final model
r = extrusion

    .circle(0.0312)  # Draw the inner circle

import cadquery as cq

# Hollow cylindrical tube
# Outer diameter = 0.0704, inner diameter = 0.0604 (thin wall), length = 0.75

outer_dia = 0.0704
inner_dia = 0.0604
length = 0.75

outer = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(outer_dia / 2).extrude(length)
inner = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(inner_dia / 2).extrude(length)

r = outer.cut(inner)
